scripts.build:shared: npm run build -w @sanny/i18n && npm run build -w @sanny/styles && npm run build -w @sanny/ui
scripts.build:login: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w login
scripts.build:sanny: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w sanny
scripts.build:frontends: npm run build:login && npm run build:sanny && npm run build:docs
scripts.build:all: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontends
scripts.serve:docs: npm run build -w docs && npm run serve -w docs
scripts.serve:docs-de: npm run build -w docs -- --locale de && npm run serve -w docs
scripts.lint:shared: npm run lint -w @sanny/i18n && npm run lint -w @sanny/styles && npm run lint -w @sanny/ui
scripts.lint:frontends: npm run lint:login && npm run lint:sanny && npm run lint:shared && npm run lint:docs
scripts.lint: npm run format:check && npm run lint:frontends && npm run lint:backend
scripts.test:frontends: npm run lint:frontends && npm run test:components && npm run build:frontends
scripts.test:backend: npm run lint:backend && npm run test -w backend
scripts.test:backend:redis: docker compose --project-directory backend/docker --env-file backend/.env run --rm --no-deps --build -e RUN_REAL_REDIS_TESTS=true app node --import=tsx --test src/tests/session-rotation.test.ts
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e:mocked && npm run test:e2e:real
scripts.test:e2e:headed: npm run test:e2e:mocked:headed && npm run test:e2e:real:headed
scripts.test: npm run format:check && npm run test:backend && npm run test:backend:redis && npm run test:frontends && npm run test:e2e
